prompt: This query should list every student with their course title (students with no enrollment show a NULL title, ordered by name then title) but it silently drops some students. Find the bug and fix it.
starterCode:
SELECT s.name, c.title
FROM students s
JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id
ORDER BY s.name, c.title;
hint: Which students disappear, and what kind of join removes rows that have no match?
